description: Fetch one remote post the calling tenant registered, by its record URI.

main.description: Returns one of the calling tenant's registered remote posts. Another tenant's registration reads as not found. A post whose repo has been unreachable for 30 days has `available: false` and no `embed`.

errors.name: RemotePostNotFound
errors.description: The calling tenant has not registered this URI.

errors.name: RemotePostDeleted
errors.description: The registration was removed, by the tenant or because the record was deleted from its repo.
